raw_output:
alias: 卧室温度调节
description: 当卧室温度高于26度时，将空调设置为24度
triggers:
  - platform: state
    entity_id: climate.bedroom_ac
    to: '26.0'
conditions:
  - condition: state
    entity_id: climate.bedroom_ac
    attribute: current_temperature
    above: 26
actions:
  - service: climate.set_temperature
    target:
      entity_id: climate.bedroom_ac
    data:
      temperature: 24
mode: single
